title: Social accounts
description: Pages, profiles and channels connected for your clients.
reconnectHint: The platform stopped accepting this connection. Reconnect to keep publishing.

empty.title: No accounts connected yet
empty.description: Connect a Facebook Page, Instagram account, YouTube channel or TikTok account for one of your clients.

disconnectWarning: We’ll stop using this account and delete its saved access. You can connect it again later.

connect.title: Connect a social account
connect.noClients: Create a client first — every account belongs to a client.
connect.redirectHint: You’ll sign in on the platform and choose what to share. We never see your password.

connectErrors.ACCESS_DENIED: The connection was cancelled on the platform. Nothing was connected.
connectErrors.STATE_INVALID: This connection attempt expired. Please start again.
connectErrors.NO_ACCOUNTS: We didn’t find any Pages, profiles or channels on that login.
connectErrors.PLATFORM_ERROR: The platform didn’t respond as expected. Please try again in a moment.

selection.title: Choose accounts to connect
selection.description: Pick the Pages, profiles or channels to add.
selection.connected: {count, plural, one {# account connected.} other {# accounts connected.}}

oauthError.title: Connection expired
oauthError.description: We couldn’t finish connecting that account because the attempt expired or was already used. Go back to your workspace and try again.

analyticsOffHint: Connected before analytics permissions were asked for. Reconnect and allow all permissions to see its analytics.
commentsOffHint: Connected before comment permission was asked for. Reconnect to post first comments.

connectLink.title: Connect link
connectLink.description: Send this link to your client or prospect. They sign in on each platform themselves and pick which accounts to connect: no password sharing, and no account here needed.
connectLink.expiresIn: {days, plural, one {Expires in # day} other {Expires in # days}}
connectLink.createdHint: Copy it now: for security it won't be shown again.
connectLink.whatsAppMessage: Please connect your social media accounts here, it only takes a minute: {url}
connectLink.revokeConfirm: Turn off this link? Anyone who has it won't be able to use it.

publicConnect.title: Connect {client}'s social accounts
publicConnect.invitedBy: {workspace} asked you to connect them, so they can manage your social media.

promises.ownLogin: You sign in on the platform itself. Your password is never shared.
promises.access: {workspace} will be able to publish posts and read analytics for the accounts you pick.
promises.remove: You can remove this access at any time from the platform's settings.

publicConnect.noPlatforms: No platforms are available right now. Please contact the agency.
publicConnect.goneHint: It may have expired or been turned off. Ask the agency for a new link.
publicConnect.pickFor: These will be connected for {client}. Untick any you don't want to share.
publicConnect.doneHint: These accounts are now connected. You can close this page, or go back to the link to connect another platform.
publicConnect.loadFailed: We couldn't open this link right now
